description:
Open the existing architectural floor plan at /home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf in LibreCAD. Create two new layers: 'FIRE-ALARM-DEVICES' with red color (color index 1) and 'FIRE-ALARM-WIRING' with yellow color (color index 2). 

On the FIRE-ALARM-DEVICES layer:
1. Draw four circles (radius 8) representing smoke detectors at centers: (120, 180), (360, 180), (120, 380), and (360, 380).
2. Draw a rectangle for the Fire Alarm Control Panel (FACP) with the lower-left corner at (220, 30), width 40, and height 25.
3. Add text labels (height 10) near the devices: 'SD-1' at (130, 190), 'SD-2' at (370, 190), 'SD-3' at (130, 390), 'SD-4' at (370, 390), and 'FACP' at (225, 60).

On the FIRE-ALARM-WIRING layer:
1. Draw two polylines (wiring runs) connecting the devices. Run 1: (240, 55) -> (120, 55) -> (120, 180) -> (120, 380). Run 2: (240, 55) -> (360, 55) -> (360, 180) -> (360, 380).

Save the annotated drawing as /home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan_fire_alarm.dxf.
